lines.text: Every task needs a title. And naming it often takes longer than writing the task.
Agent R Q writes it for you. With its own small model, running right in your browser.
Ada types what she needs. The checkout still shows the old price after a coupon is removed.
She clicks the sparkle beside the title.
Fix checkout price after coupon removal. Short, and it keeps the detail that matters.
A chatty request works too. Can you draft a reply to the Acme renewal email? Draft Acme renewal email.
Or skip the title. Create the task, and for a moment it is called Untitled.
Then the browser names it in the background. Rerun nightly S 3 export.
Nothing is sent anywhere to write a title. The task text never leaves your device.
It is Agent R Q's own model, fine tuned for this one job. Anyone can use it, free, under the Apache license.
On a thousand test tasks, it wrote a good title ninety eight percent of the time. Flan T 5 base managed seventy five.
Write the task, skip the title. What would you hand off first? Tell us in the comments, and try it at Agent R Q dot com.
